The '''Yunu''' were a large, furred, sentient [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Arkinnea]]. They lived in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] forests, and allied with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] refugees led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]], helping them establish a [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|secret temple]] there.

They seemed to have been aware of the Jedi for a very long time, able to recognize the group as Jedi and kneel down in respect after [[Sidirri]] had killed the [[Arkinnea Militia]] with her [[Force power/Legends|force power]] and know the location of an abandoned temple and even recognized it being owned by the Jedi. Master [[Zao]] noted they possessed stories of the Jedi and still looked upon them with respect and fondness.
